caption: The drawing depicts two reddish-brown bricks, each occupying the center of the image and aligned vertically. The upper brick has simple linear engravings on its front surface, depicting abstract geometric shapes and lines; the left side shows three rectangular, prong-like shapes, while the right side features intersecting lines and rectangles, with a circled area containing a dotted internal pattern and a radiating mark at the top. The lower brick displays a carved pair of scissors with circular handles and straight blades, oriented diagonally in an "X" shape. The bricks have a rough texture and irregular edges, with dark shadowing along the upper and side edges for depth. The background of the drawing is a pale, off-white color, devoid of other objects or patterns.
title: Bishop Hill: Building Bricks
